about.lead: UR PIR panels are FM Global (FM) APPROVED — Class 1 to FM Approvals Standard 4880 / 4881, without height restrictions.

data.title: FM Global (FM) Approval
data.body: PIR is recognised as a fire-safer alternative to many other foam cores. UR PIR panels are FM Global (FM) APPROVED to Class 1 under FM Approvals Standards 4880 and 4881 — without height restrictions.

data.title: FM Room Test (UBC-26)
data.body:
In order to obtain FM Approvals Standard 4880, UR PIR panels are subjected to a number of stringent tests. One of these tests is the UBC-26 room test.

UR PIR panels test results show that fire is contained in the room and there is no fire propagation to the extremities of the panel construction.

data.title: FM Global (FM) Approval
data.body:
PIR is recognised by the industry as the fire safe alternative to other foam cores. UR PIR panel is FM Global (FM) APPROVED.

UR PIR panels obtained Class 1 fire rating according to FM Approvals Standard 4880 and 4881. These ratings are valid without height restrictions.

data.overviewTitle: ASEAN’s first Double Belt Continuous Line
data.overviewBody1: Over the past 30 years, we have been recognised as one of the most established panel manufacturers in our industry. Our continuous effort in keeping up with our market’s current technology extends to our manufacturing capabilities. All of our PIR panels are manufactured in our own premises to ensure that tight control and stringent quality standards are met.
data.overviewBody2: We are the first PIR Double Belt Continuous production line in the ASEAN region for insulation purposes. A PIR continuous production line is ideal for high-volume production of insulating panels, and our specialised team is able to cater for this complex turnkey manufacturing system.
data.featuresLead: PIR has the best insulation rating of all widely-used thermal insulation materials due to the low heat-conductivity. In addition to its thermal performance, PIR panels offer:
features: Superior fire resistance — reduced flammability compared with other panel cores
Stronger parallel compression strength — better dimensional stability
More savings — lower energy costs for both heating and cooling
Faster delivery time — foam has a faster reaction rate
No restrictions on length in a single panel — produced on a continuous line
Environmental benefits — PIR cores contain no CFCs or HCFCs
ASEAN’s first PIR Double Belt Continuous Line for insulation, with in-house manufacture under stringent quality control
Ideal for high-volume production — specialised team support for complex turnkey manufacturing

data.title: Fire-critical cold stores deserve FM PIR
data.body: FM-approved polyisocyanurate (PIR) panels deliver excellent fire performance for cold storage envelopes. The PIR core is produced via a continuous process with a pentane blowing agent — an ozone-friendly choice for modern facilities.
data.body2: Specify PIR where fire rating, thermal performance, and continuous-line consistency matter most — from freezer rooms to large distribution centres.

items.text: The first and only PIR Double Belt Continuous Line in ASEAN for cold store panels.

data.title: ASEAN’s first Double Belt Continuous Line
data.body: Over the past 30 years, we have been recognised as one of the most established panel manufacturers in our industry. Our continuous effort in keeping up with our market’s current technology extends to our manufacturing capabilities. All of our PIR panels are manufactured in our own premises to ensure that tight control and stringent quality standards are met.
data.body2: We are the first PIR Double Belt Continuous production line in the ASEAN region for insulation purposes. A PIR continuous production line is ideal for high-volume production of insulating panels, and our specialised team is able to cater for this complex turnkey manufacturing system.

data.title: What PIR panels offer
data.lead: PIR has the best insulation rating of all widely-used thermal insulation materials due to the low heat-conductivity. In addition to its thermal performance, PIR panels offer:
items: Superior fire resistance — reduced flammability compared with other panel cores
Moisture resistant — closed-cell foam properties
Stronger parallel compression strength — better dimensional stability
More savings — lower energy costs for both heating and cooling
Faster delivery time — foam has a faster reaction rate
No restrictions on length in a single panel — produced on a continuous line
Environmental benefits — PIR cores contain no CFCs or HCFCs
ASEAN’s first PIR Double Belt Continuous Line for insulation, with in-house manufacture under stringent quality control
Ideal for high-volume production — specialised team support for complex turnkey manufacturing

data.title: What is RockWool?
data.body: RockWool is a mineral wool insulation made from natural stone fibres. In cold room panels, it provides stable thermal insulation with a core valued for its non-combustible character, durability, and reliable performance in temperature-controlled environments.

items.title: Fire Performance
items.text: Mineral fibre core supports stronger fire resilience for industrial and cold storage environments.

items.title: Thermal Stability
items.text: Reliable insulation behaviour to help protect temperature-controlled spaces.

items.title: Dimensional Integrity
items.text: A robust core that holds form under demanding operating conditions.

items.title: Acoustic Comfort
items.text: Natural fibre structure contributes to quieter, more controlled facilities.

data.title: Automation that sets a new benchmark
data.lead: United Panel brings RockWool panel production into a fully automated line — the first of its kind in Malaysia. The result is repeatable quality, tighter process control, and panels built for professional cold room projects.
items: Local manufacturing capability you can visit and verify
High-level process control for consistent panel output
Cold room expertise backed by United Panel’s panel heritage
Standard range published — thickness, joint, skins and finishes

data.title: What a RockWool panel is

data.body2: Clients receive a ready panel product — not raw insulation alone. The RockWool core sits between protective metal skins, ready for cold rooms, food facilities, data-centre envelopes, and industrial walls.

data.title: Project Site Tour
data.body:
During the COVID-19 pandemic, cold storage became more essential than ever. Food consumption and storage soared under lockdowns, increasing demand for reliable refrigerated facilities.

United Panel-System (M) Sdn. Bhd. operated around the clock, manufacturing insulation panels to meet urgent timelines — with FM Approval as the gold standard.

We were tasked by the government to deliver emergency cold rooms and refrigeration solutions in response to the pandemic.

Insulation panels and cold storage remain pivotal to food security, healthcare logistics, and vaccine storage infrastructure.
